title: Design: whether an accounted unadmitted change at the declared revision should keep an acceptance evaluation fresh instead of voiding it
outcome: Keep the original acceptance evaluation fresh when the first accounted unadmitted source observation after restart repeats the complete comparable SourceId that the evaluation declared on its named workspace root and generation. Preserve the barriers for actual changes and for bound checks, and preserve reroll evidence rules.
acceptance: Record the Engram and TermAl coordinators’ decision adopting option B and name the Engram acceptance evaluator as the contract owner. A post-cut accounted, unadmitted assumed_missing_baseline report on the evaluation’s named workspace root and generation can preserve freshness only when its complete comparable SourceId equals the evaluation’s explicit declaration. Its own triggered obligation is seen for freshness without waiving it.

Revise the acceptance contract and pinned tests before changing basis_moved_after. Cover the w-5896 position-257 sequence completing with the original evaluation ID, and verify that content_comparison, real source movement, missing or incomparable identity, wrong named workspace or generation, and a bound check still block where applicable. Preserve the reroll new-evidence rule.
